description_en: Cancels an automatic snapshot policy for cloud computers

kebab_example: aliyun ecd cancel-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id sp-78lhzpe7kjfnd0000 --desktop-id ecd-itcmrhqt01tdl0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy
